verdict.rationale: Bolna's own docs describe a quickstart that goes from an API key to a real phone call, with transcript and recording, in about five minutes. Agent Studio generates a call-ready agent in 5 to 8 minutes, and voices are selectable. Phone numbers can be managed through the CLI or built-in telephony providers such as Twilio and Plivo, which comfortably fits an under-an-hour first live call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of acquiring or assigning a phone number to an agent in the first-call flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the time-to-first-call claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Go from an API key to a real phone call (with a transcript and recording) in four steps.
verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes.
You can choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles to match your brand.
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
Instead of using Bolna's built-in telephony providers (Twilio, Plivo, etc.)
